name: branding-urbanist-type-specimen-with-modular-colour-grid
title: Urbanist Specimen with Modular Colour Grid
whatItIs: A pale grey-blue slide with a numbered Typography & Colors pill, alphabet lines, a type scale (36, 24, 16), a giant black 'Urbanist' specimen and a grid of hairline cells in which four colours (white, black, blue, grey) appear as a circle or a filled cell with hex codes.
whatItMeans: Placing swatches on a hairline grid makes the palette feel architectural, and the huge word makes the typeface unmistakable.
techniques: Hairline modular grid of unequal cells
Colours shown as circles and one full cell
Blue as the sole colour accent

vocabulary.definition: A grid of cells of different sizes.
An outlined label holding a colour code.
Sizes for title, subtitle and body.
